claim: The inventory list (inventory/inventory.service.ts fetchLotRollup + mapInventoryItem) and the price-lock list (pricing/price-locks.service.ts list) read inventory_lot_agreed_cost and take their unit cost from resolveUnitCost, the same answer analytics and margin advice give, so the inventory page and price locks cannot disagree with analytics and an unknown cost stays null (QA round 22, #945 gap).
